key_decisions.after: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen temporary residents of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves triune structure, blood imagery and increased blessing.
key_decisions.before: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
key_decisions.after: chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, by the Spirit's sanctifying work, for obedience and sprinkling with Jesus Christ's blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps blessing, rebirth, living hope and resurrection.
key_decisions.before: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
key_decisions.after: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he gave us new birth into a living hope through Jesus Christ's resurrection from the dead,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves joy and grief together and does not dismiss the suffering.
key_decisions.before: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
key_decisions.after: You rejoice in this, though for a little while now, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps refining comparison, all three results and future revelation.
key_decisions.before: so that the tested genuineness of your trust—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than perishable gold tested by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders souls as lives while keeping salvation as faith's end.
key_decisions.before: obtaining the outcome of your trust, the salvation of your souls.
key_decisions.after: receiving the outcome of your faith: the salvation of your lives.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: obtaining the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains uncertainty of timing/person, Spirit and suffering/glory sequence.
key_decisions.before: inquiring what person or time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the subsequent glories.
key_decisions.after: They investigated what person or time the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating when he testified beforehand about Christ's sufferings and the glories to follow.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: inquiring what person or time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the subsequent glories.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps prophetic service, Spirit-sent proclamation and angelic desire.
key_decisions.before: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through people who preached the good news to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.
key_decisions.after: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you in the things now announced to you through those who brought you the good news by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things angels long to look into.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains ancient clothing image, sobriety and future grace.
key_decisions.before: So, preparing your minds for action and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, with the loins of your mind girded and fully sober, set your hope completely on the grace being brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, preparing your minds for action and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Father/judge tension, individual deeds and alien status.

key_decisions.after: If you call on as Father the one who judges each person's work impartially, live with reverent fear during the time of your temporary residence.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if you call on him as Father who judges impartially according to each one’s deeds, conduct yourselves with fear throughout the time of your exile,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inherited conduct, ransom and precious-metal contrast.
key_decisions.before: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,
key_decisions.after: You know that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down by your ancestors, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains blood, value and sacrificial animal comparison.
key_decisions.before: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.
key_decisions.after: but with Christ's precious blood, like that of an unblemished and spotless lamb.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps purification, sibling love and intensity.

key_decisions.after: Since you have purified your lives by obedience to the truth for sincere family love, love one another earnestly from the heart.
